title: A helpdesk on your WhatsApp number
summary: Every new message to your business's WhatsApp number becomes a numbered ticket for the right department; customers' next messages join their ticket.
description: Customers write to your business's own WhatsApp number (connected with the WhatsApp Cloud API). A message from someone with no open ticket becomes a ticket with a number (T-1042), saved in your tickets table, and they are answered at once on WhatsApp with their number. Their next messages join their ticket, the ticket is open again and the department is told. A message after their ticket was resolved more than a few days ago (you choose how many) opens a new ticket that says which one it follows. You write your departments once; Taskiem's AI (or your words, or the customer's choice) sends each ticket to the right one, and its members are told on WhatsApp, Telegram or by email. They answer with the Answer customers' tickets form. Also add Send ticket answers from your WhatsApp number, which sends every answer from your number.

variables.name: ticket_reply_form
variables.why: The link of your ticket reply form (the Answer customers' tickets workflow), put in each message to a department so they can answer at once.

params.name: whatsapp_connection
params.title: WhatsApp connection
params.description: Your business's WhatsApp number (WhatsApp Cloud API), the one your customers write to.

params.name: departments
params.title: Departments
params.description: One department per line: its name, the role whose members answer its tickets, what it looks after, and words that send a ticket there, separated by a | sign. For example: Billing | accounts | Payments, invoices and refunds | refund, invoice, payment
params.example:
Billing | accounts | Payments, invoices and refunds | refund, invoice, payment, charged
Delivery | dispatch | Orders on their way, late or damaged deliveries | delivery, late, rider, damaged
General | support | Anything else |

params.name: default_department
params.title: Department when none fits
params.description: One of your departments, by its name: it gets the tickets that fit no other.

params.name: routing
params.title: How a ticket finds its department
params.description: ai: Taskiem's AI reads the message and picks the department, how urgent it is and a one-line summary. rules: the first department with one of its words in the message. chosen: the department the customer picked.

params.name: acknowledgement
params.title: What the customer is told first
params.description: The first answer a customer gets when they write; their ticket's reference is added after it.
params.default: Thank you for getting in touch. We have your message and will answer you soon.
params.example: Thank you for getting in touch. We have your message and will answer you soon.

params.name: reopen_days
params.title: Days a resolved ticket can be reopened
params.description: A customer who writes back within these days after their ticket was resolved reopens it; later, they get a new ticket that says which one it follows.

definition.name: Helpdesk on WhatsApp
definition.description: Opens a ticket for each customer who writes to the WhatsApp number with no open ticket, and adds their next messages to it.

output.text: =(trigger.item.message.?text.?body.orValue('') != '' ? trigger.item.message.text.body : trigger.item.message.?interactive.?button_reply.?title.orValue('') != '' ? trigger.item.message.interactive.button_reply.title : trigger.item.message.?interactive.?list_reply.?title.orValue('') != '' ? trigger.item.message.interactive.list_reply.title : trigger.item.message.?button.?text.orValue('') != '' ? trigger.item.message.button.text : trigger.item.message.?image.?caption.orValue('') != '' ? trigger.item.message.image.caption : trigger.item.message.?document.?caption.orValue('') != '' ? trigger.item.message.document.caption : '(a ' + trigger.item.message.?type.orValue('message') + ' with no text)')

steps.name: Find the customer's last WhatsApp ticket
Is it a new ticket or more on one
Add the message to its ticket, or open a ticket
Leave reactions and system notices alone
Add the customer's message to the ticket
Tell the department the customer wrote
